newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ's Countrywide Bank cuts floating mortgage rate.
newsitem.headline: NZ's Countrywide Bank cuts floating mortgage rate.

text.p: Countrywide Bank said on Tuesday it had dropped its floating mortgage interest rate to 9.95 percent from 10.75 percent in response to news that the NZ First Party had entered into a coalition with the caretaker National Party government.
Countrywide said the new rate was effective immediately for new customers and from January 13, 1997 for existing customers.
The bank said the cut was a vote of confidence in New Zealand's economic direction.
